skipped.reason: redundancy of multiple instances has no observable outcome: a creature with two double strike abilities deals damage in exactly the same two steps as with one, which 702.4b-1 and 702.4b-3 already show

scenarios.title: A double striker deals damage in the first step, before a blocker that has neither first strike nor double strike
decisions: A attacks player B with Fencing Ace.
B blocks Fencing Ace with Mons's Goblin Raiders.
No spells or abilities are used; both combat damage steps happen.

variants.label: double_strike
variants.expected: In the first combat damage step only Fencing Ace deals damage: 1 damage to Mons's Goblin Raiders, which is destroyed. In the second step, with its blocker gone and no trample, Fencing Ace deals no damage. Fencing Ace survives with 0 damage marked. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: plain_attacker
variants.delta: A's attacker is a second Mons's Goblin Raiders (1/1, no abilities) instead of Fencing Ace.
variants.expected: There is a single combat damage step. Each Mons's Goblin Raiders deals 1 damage to the other and both are destroyed. B's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: A blocker without first strike or double strike deals damage only in the second step, after taking damage in the first
decisions: A attacks player B with Fencing Ace.
B blocks Fencing Ace with Grizzly Bears.
No spells or abilities are used; both combat damage steps happen.

variants.label: double_strike
variants.expected: First combat damage step: Fencing Ace deals 1 damage to Grizzly Bears; Grizzly Bears deals none. Second step: Fencing Ace deals 1 more damage (2 total, lethal) while Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Fencing Ace. Both are destroyed.

variants.label: plain_attacker
variants.delta: A's attacker is Mons's Goblin Raiders (1/1, no abilities) instead of Fencing Ace.
variants.expected: There is a single combat damage step. The attacker deals 1 damage to Grizzly Bears, which survives with 1 damage marked; Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage and destroys the attacker.

scenarios.title: An unblocked double striker deals combat damage in both steps
decisions: A attacks player B with Fencing Ace.
No spells or abilities are used; both combat damage steps happen.

variants.label: double_strike
variants.expected: Fencing Ace deals 1 damage to B in the first combat damage step and 1 more in the second. B's life is 18.

variants.label: plain_attacker
variants.delta: A's attacker is Mons's Goblin Raiders (1/1, no abilities) instead of Fencing Ace.
variants.expected: There is a single combat damage step in which the attacker deals 1 damage to B. B's life is 19.

scenarios.title: Removing double strike during the first combat damage step stops damage in the second step
decisions: A attacks player B with Fencing Ace.
The first combat damage step happens; Fencing Ace deals 1 damage to B.
After that damage, B receives priority and casts Turn to Frog targeting Fencing Ace, tapping both Islands; both players pass and it resolves.
The second combat damage step happens.

variants.label: frogged
variants.expected: Fencing Ace deals 1 damage in the first step (B's life 19). Turn to Frog removes all its abilities, so it deals no damage in the second step. B's life stays 19.

variants.label: not_frogged
variants.delta: B does not cast Turn to Frog.
variants.expected: Fencing Ace deals 1 damage in each step. B's life is 18.

scenarios.title: Giving double strike to a first striker after it dealt first-strike damage lets it deal damage again
decisions: A attacks player B with Youthful Knight.
The first combat damage step happens; Youthful Knight (first strike) deals 2 damage to B.

After that damage, A receives priority and casts Boros Charm choosing 'target creature gains double strike until end of turn', targeting Youthful Knight, tapping Mountain and Plains; both players pass and it resolves.
The second combat damage step happens.

variants.label: charm_after_first_strike
variants.expected: Youthful Knight deals 2 damage in the first step (B's life 18) and, having double strike when the second step begins, 2 more in the second. B's life is 16.

variants.label: no_charm
variants.delta: A does not cast Boros Charm.
variants.expected: Youthful Knight deals 2 damage in the first step only; it deals none in the second. B's life is 18.
